examples.description: Use the `copied` prop to control the copy button animation externally. This lets you copy different text (e.g. from a context card) while reusing the snippet's checkmark feedback.

examples.heading: Placeholder
examples.description: An empty text with a placeholder: the client code adds opacity-50 to the root and shows the placeholder in the pre; the page has no such example.
